blind.description: A small conical heap of stylized human skulls with a few limb bones intermingled around the bottom and sides. The geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled as a cohesive game-ready prop. Surfaces are textured in aged bone tones (beige and tan with darker brown shading in the eye sockets and recesses). The pile sits directly on the floor with no plinth, base, or floating artifacts.
blind.from_above: A rounded, roughly circular cluster of skull domes and protruding bone ends with a central skull forming the peak.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.5 ft tall) and roughly 1.5 to 2 ft wide.
